method.difference: four circle rows minus one common reference row; difference rank <= 3; zero for Z-Z or identical physical circles, and nonzero only Z-NZ
method.anonymous: only the two overlap-forced off-shell witness roles are admitted, and only beside named points from which they are certified distinct; cross-arm witnesses are never used together
overlap_consequences: at least two erase_M_at_O support points are off Sigma_A
at least two erase_K_at_O support points are off Sigma_B
method.selected_subset_warning: the erased O-centered rows are selected four-subsets, so absence from them is not off-circle evidence
